description: Pick a provider before writing integration code: LLM API, code sandbox, vector DB, web search, email, Postgres, auth, browser, observability. First call: set a stable clientInfo.name (e.g. acme-support-agent), then {task:'run untrusted Python in a sandbox'}. Returns the dated Depot Pick, runner-up, sourced price, when to skip it, reportOutcome, recheck. Recheck: since=recheck.since (unchanged = short reply). Quotes: depot.
